notes.title: Chat with the Voice Actress
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40376419/75a5281aaa6d741d46fa376ce49f3f4ba0a70aba.gif

Play The Death Into Trouble Free demo!
Steam Next Fest starts TODAY and we hope you have a lot of fun!

Between October 1st - 7th, you'll be able to explore the Purgatory initial sectors and a small part of Heaven and Hell. This small portion of the experience should give you a taste of what's to come in the full game.

we've also pinned a [discussion post] where you can leave your feedback about our demo.

Click "Set reminder" and don't miss our Live Streams :)

Day 1 - October 4
20:00 BRT / 16:00 PDT (click here to convert the time to your timezone)

Day 2 - October 5
14:00 BRT / 10:00 PDT (click here to convert the time to your timezone)

See you all in the stream!

If you haven't already, you can wishlist The Death Into Trouble below, so you don't miss the launch discount ːsteamhappyː
